name: Rice Vinegar
siboNotes: Rice vinegar is well-tolerated and may help with digestion due to its acidity. Use freely in SIBO-friendly recipes.
preparationTips: Choose unseasoned rice vinegar to avoid added sugars or garlic
Store in a cool, dark place after opening
Use in salad dressings, marinades, and Asian-inspired dishes
Mix with low-FODMAP oils for quick vinaigrettes
